distribution: 西藏墨脱背崩，海拔八百米；国外分布于印度。
en: The soldier has a brownish yellow head and a dark brown nasus, with pale brown antennae and yellowish brown mandibles tipped with dark brown; the thorax and abdomen are brown above and the legs pale brownish yellow. At least three pairs of setae stand on the dorsum of the head, several short hairs on the thorax, and hairs of mixed length on the abdomen. The hind part of the head is slightly narrowed, the front margin straight and the hind margin slightly arched.
soldier: 兵蚁头部棕黄，象鼻暗棕，触角淡棕，上颚带黄褐而尖端棕黑；胸、腹部背面棕色，足淡棕黄。头背面至少具毛三对，胸部有数根短毛，腹部兼具长短毛，鼻端亦生短毛。头后部稍狭，前缘平直，后缘中央微微弓起。前胸背板比头为窄，形如马鞍，其前缘仅在中部略有凹陷，后缘近乎平直。胫节距二比二比二，跗节四节。
